dioscorides.excerpt: ὑπερικόν· οἱ δὲ ἀνδρόσαιμον, οἱ δὲ κόριον, οἱ δὲ χαμαίπιτυν διὰ τὸ τὴν περὶ τὸ σπέρμα ὀσμὴν ἐοικέναι ῥητίνῃ πιτυΐνῃ.
dioscorides.edition: Wellmann 1906-1914 (vol. I 1907, vol. II 1906), Berlin: Weidmann; transcribed by eye from the archive.org page scan (Wellmann's ϑ glyph rendered as θ; no emendation)

identification.source: Sprengel, K. 1830. Pedanii Dioscoridis Anazarbei De materia medica libri quinque, tomus secundus (Commentarius in Dioscoridem), Medicorum Graecorum Opera vol. 26, Leipzig, Comm. lib. III cap. CLXI, pp. 566-567 (finds no Hypericum matching ὑπερικόν exactly except H. barbatum Jacq.; Sibthorp's H. crispum 'less pertinent'; assigns H. perforatum to ἄσκυρον, cap. CLXII)

alternatives.name: Hypericum barbatum Jacq.
alternatives.source: Sprengel, K. 1830. Pedanii Dioscoridis Anazarbei De materia medica libri quinque, tomus secundus (Commentarius in Dioscoridem), Medicorum Graecorum Opera vol. 26, Leipzig, p. 567

alternatives.name: Hypericum crispum L. (= H. triquetrifolium Turra) (Sibthorp, as reported by Sprengel)
alternatives.source: Sprengel, K. 1830. Pedanii Dioscoridis Anazarbei De materia medica libri quinque, tomus secundus (Commentarius in Dioscoridem), Medicorum Graecorum Opera vol. 26, Leipzig, p. 567

caveats: Identification is disputed; results describe Hypericum perforatum L., which may not be the plant Dioscorides meant.
